set.body: Specify the exact ownership and layout mapping required before any zero-copy Gale/Ravel adapter exists. Acceptance criteria: define treatment of positive-stride rank-one and rank-two views; negative strides; zero-stride broadcast views; empty dimensions; transposes; owned, borrowed, and mutable inputs; exclusive mutable destinations; alias detection; copy-versus-reject behavior; and checked reachable-address validation. The contract must preserve DVec and DMat semantics and must not imply that Gale accepts every Ravel layout.
set.title: Specify Gale/Ravel zero-copy layout compatibility
